comment: Feature flags for parallel update safety. Toggle new code paths on/off without restart. Edit this file to enable/disable; changes take effect on next flag check (hot-reload).

shadow_mode_enabled.description: Run new logic alongside old, compare results, log discrepancies

circuit_breaker_hot_reload.description: Circuit breaker protection on hot-reload operations

resource_aware_hot_update.description: Defer reload of resource-holding modules to idle periods

outbox_async_replay.description: Asynchronous outbox replay consumer (non-blocking event loop)

health_check_deep_probes.description: Enable ?level=deep health checks with live TCP dependency probes

new_ipc_handler_v2.description: Example: new IPC handler implementation behind feature flag

automatic_repair_execution.description: Execute automatic repairs without explicit user confirmation. Disabled: faults are classified and queued for confirmation in the Xingcheng assistant panel.

automatic_update_execution.description: Apply automatic backend/third-party updates without explicit user confirmation. Disabled: update intents are queued for confirmation in the Xingcheng assistant panel.

user_confirmation_release.description: Release switch: allows a user-confirmed pending action (repair or update) to execute. While disabled, the assistant panel buttons are wired but every confirmation is refused with RELEASE_NOT_GRANTED.
